amendment_before_outcomes: Root-requested unfiltered top8 partition control before any model/runtime/score outcome; v1 preserved.

calibration.queries: endpoint outer TRAIN positives and native TRAIN negative bank
calibration.support: exact existing endpoint/random positive-union target mask

cost_gate: Separate complete61-episode cost for each of five new arms, all own member cycles. Charge source/input load, calibration/native gradient, own filter/SVD work, full optimizer/cycle/checkpoint/selection/serving costs, warm20 receipt, peak CUDA+RSS and storage. No shorter-cycle estimate or automatic cap expansion.
dataset: Official fixed HeaRT Citeseer split;3327nodes/3703features/3870TRAIN/227VALID/fixed500VALID negatives. No downloads, TEST loader or synthetic performance claim.
decisions: Stop before fit on native forward/old-gradient/live-incoming/usable-rank/projector gate failure.

Either unfiltered repeated-top2 or disjoint-top8-partition matches: graph-filtered initialization utility closes. The partition control is necessary because repeated-top2 alone confounds filtering with initial projector diversity/coverage.
Mean member competence or paid cost-quality tradeoff worsens: close quality hypothesis.
Capable rank8 native single explains result: no demonstrated need for member-specific growth.
Independent4 explains graph growth: only measured sharing cost-quality tradeoff remains.

geometry.independent_control_member_inner: Allfour inner lists concatenate, as competent single; four independent copies pay this cost each.

growth: NativeBase + native_linear_tail_JK[P tanh(H V_m) B_m], V0, B right Stiefel basis. Equivalent in real arithmetic to inserting correction before native linear tail/JK. Native base PH/tail/stack/JK arithmetic remains literal.

growth_geometry.filter_scope: Only initialize output subspaces. V/B are learned freely; no persistent graph-frequency specialization is imposed.

heldout: TEST has no loader path. Root must freeze every arm/seed/claim first, then separately score every selected bank once without adaptation/reselection.
independent_seeds: base_seed+5*m, m0..3, exactly existing common-warm independent-control stream convention

initializers.capable_single_rank8: Complete learnable native nonlinear single; B top8 unfiltered right basis, V0, eight new tanh message units; same4096 new parameters.
initializers.graph_growth: Four Bernstein bands q0..3; K_q=H^T P^T F_q(P)G, Fq=binom(3,q)(I+P)^(3-q)(I-P)^q/8; B top2 right singular vectors, V0.
initializers.independent_graph_growth4: Four complete native encoder/head warm copies, each with corresponding graph rank2 basis and V0. No parameters or Adam state shared; no pooled-gradient objective.
initializers.unfiltered_growth: Same shared nonlinear rank2/member architecture; all four B use top2 right basis of K=H^T P^T G, V0. No diversity gate is claimed for this intentionally repeated basis.
initializers.unfiltered_top8_partition: Same unfiltered K=H^T P^T G and same top8 right basis as capable single, partitioned into four disjoint2-row blocks (rows0:2,2:4,4:6,6:8). Same nonlinear shared architecture, V0,4096 new parameters. Controls initial output-subspace diversity/coverage without graph-error filtering.

limits: No recovery of information absent from H/context.
Stiefel optimization concerns filtered proxy; it does not universally maximize actual incoming gradient.
Adam magnitude/saturation and nonlinear dynamics remove raw-gradient-norm benefit guarantees.
Three optimizer seeds on one graph/split supply no graph-generalization/significance certificate.
Prior GradMax/nonlinear-message/filter/low-rank ancestry; no novelty certification.
loss: Original equal-cardinality BCE logsigmoid, three committed ordinary Adam passes inner/outer/repeated-inner. Across shared growth variants: identical0.5BCE(mean raw logits)+0.5mean memberBCE outer, mean own inner losses.
native_operator: P=diag((1+deg)^(-1/2))(A+I)diag((1+deg)^(-1/2)); A is unchanged provider symmetric unweighted target-masked TRAIN support with no selfloops.
primary_contrasts: graph_growth versus capable_single_rank8 and independent_graph_growth4 at paid cost
retained_no_growth_reference: Existing same-seed warm_identity source/results are retained; new qualifier checks literal no-growth source. No duplicated no-growth fit/cost is admitted by this runner.
selection: First strict maximum complete pooled VALID MRR rounded4 at cycles5,10,...60; no early stop. Independent control has separate optimizers but a synchronous pooled selector, explicitly a joint-selection/common-warm adaptation.
single_independent_loss: Own BCE; native single/each independent member concatenates all four inner lists. Each member uses its own outer BCE and Adam, without pooled-loss coupling.
site: Native GCN xemb Dropout(.4)->Linear3703x256->Dropout(.3,inplace), one PureConv gcn, taildropout0, scalar unnormalized JK; no residual.
warm_binding: Root-authenticated exact seed terminal20 TRAIN-only common warm checkpoint; no old source/state mutation or optimizer continuation.
